--- /workspace/hashing.py
+++ /workspace/hashing.py
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
@@ -1,0 +3,36 @@
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import sys
+from getpass import getpass
+
+
+def sha256_hex(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(password.encode("utf-8"))
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Hash a password using SHA-256 and output the hex digest.")
+    src = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
+    src.add_argument("-p", "--password", help="Password to hash (not recommended; may be visible in process list)")
+    src.add_argument("--stdin", action="store_true", help="Read password from STDIN")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    if args.password is not None:
+        password = args.password
+    elif args.stdin:
+        password = sys.stdin.read()
+        if password.endswith("\n"):
+            password = password[:-1]
+    else:
+        password = getpass("Password: ")
+
+    print(hash_password(password))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+
